keyVerseDR: "Young man, I say to thee, arise." (Lk 7:14)

level1.title: Jesus Helps a Mom
level1.story: Jesus saw a widow crying. Her only son had died. Jesus said, "Do not cry," touched the coffin, and said, "Young man, arise!" He sat up and spoke!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you help someone sad?
level1.prayer: Jesus, comfort all who are sad. Amen.

activity.title: From sad to glad
activity.intro: Draw each face: sad before, joyful after Jesus came!

level2.title: The Widow's Son at Nain
level2.story: Jesus went to a city called Naim with His disciples and a great crowd. Near the city gate, a dead man was being carried out, the only son of his mother, who was a widow. When Jesus saw her, He had compassion and said, "Weep not." He touched the bier and said, "Young man, I say to thee, arise." The dead man sat up and began to speak, and Jesus gave him to his mother, and all glorified God.
level2.keyLine: Young man, I say to thee, arise.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus have pity on the widow?
How can you comfort a grieving person?
actions: Write a card to someone sad
level2.prayer: Jesus, give comfort and new life. Amen.

activity.title: Thank You, Jesus
activity.intro: Jesus gave the widow her son back. Write a thank-you prayer.

art.mainBrief: Jesus raising the widow's son at Nain
